entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marek Ženíšek is a Czech politician and political scientist, who served as the Czech Minister for Science and Research in the cabinet of Petr Fiala from May 2024 to December 2025. He has been vice-chairman of TOP 09 since November 2025. He was vice-chairman of TOP 09 between 2009 and 2019, and first vice-chairman from 2015 to 2017. He was a member of the Chamber of Deputies from 2013 to 2017, and again from 2021, and has served as Deputy Minister of Justice (2008-2011) and First Deputy Minister of Health (2012-2013).
